lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੀ ਤਾ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਧਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun saaree taa ka(n)t piaaree naame dharee piaaro ||
lines.translation: Dwell upon the Lord's Glories, and you shall be loved by your Husband, embracing love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman naah piaaree raam naam gal haaro ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride who wears the necklace of the Lord's Name around her neck is loved by her Husband Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਏਕਲੜੀ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan ekalaRee jeeu bin naah piaare ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride who is without her beloved Husband is all alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮੁਠੀ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai muthee jeeu bin gurasabad karaare ||
lines.translation: She is cheated by the love of duality, without the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਉਣੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabad piaare kaun dutar taare maaiaa mohi khuaaee ||
lines.translation: Without the Shabad of her Beloved, how can she cross over the treacherous ocean? Attachment to Maya has led her astray.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਤਾ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੁਤੀ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR vigutee taa pir mutee saa dhan mahal na paaee ||
lines.translation: Ruined by falsehood, she is deserted by her Husband Lord. The soul-bride does not attain the Mansion of His Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabade raatee sahaje maatee anadin rahai samaae ||
lines.translation: But she who is attuned to the Guru's Shabad is intoxicated with celestial love; night and day, she remains absorbed in Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman sadaa ra(n)g raatee har jeeu aap milaae ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, that soul-bride who remains constantly steeped in His Love, is blended by the Lord into Himself. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa mileeai har mele jeeu har bin kavan milaae ||
lines.translation: If the Lord merges us with Himself, we are merged with Him. Without the Dear Lord, who can merge us with Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਆਪਣੇ ਜੀਉ ਕਉਣੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur preetam aapane jeeu kaun bharam chukaae ||
lines.translation: Without our Beloved Guru, who can dispel our doubt?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਇਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਮਾਏ ਤਾ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bharam chukaae iu mileeai maae taa saa dhan sukh paae ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru, doubt is dispelled. O my mother, this is the way to meet Him; this is how the soul-bride finds peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa bin ghor a(n)dhaar bin gur mag na paae ||
lines.translation: Without serving the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. Without the Guru, the Way is not found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaman ra(n)g raatee sahaje maatee gur kai sabad veechaare ||
lines.translation: That wife who is intuitively imbued with the color of His Love, contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman har var paaiaa gur kai bhaai piaare ||4||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride obtains the Lord as her Husband, by enshrining love for the Beloved Guru. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਰੀ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir bin kharee nimaanee jeeu bin pir kiu jeevaa meree maaee ||
lines.translation: Without my Husband, I am utterly dishonored. Without my Husband Lord, how can I live, O my mother?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਤਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir bin need na aavai jeeu kaapaR tan na suhaaee ||
lines.translation: Without my Husband, sleep does not come, and my body is not adorned with my bridal dress.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਪਰੁ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ਜਾ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaapar tan suhaavai jaa pir bhaavai guramatee chit laaeeai ||
lines.translation: The bridal dress looks beautiful upon my body, when I am pleasing to my Husband Lord. Following the Guru's Teachings, my consciousness is focused on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa suhaagan jaa satigur seve gur kai a(n)k samaaeeai ||
lines.translation: I become His happy soul-bride forever, when I serve the True Guru; I sit in the Lap of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਮੇਲਾ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadai melaa taa pir raavee laahaa naam sa(n)saare ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the soul-bride meets her Husband Lord, who ravishes and enjoys her. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only profit in this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman naah piaaree jaa har ke gun saare ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride is loved by her Husband, when she dwells upon the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa dhan ra(n)g maane jeeu aapane naal piaare ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride enjoys the Love of her Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis ra(n)g raatee jeeu gurasabad veechaare ||
lines.translation: Imbued with His Love night and day, she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabad veechaare haumai maare in bidh milahu piaare ||
lines.translation: Contemplating the Guru's Shabad, she conquers her ego, and in this way, she meets her Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa dhan sohaagan sadaa ra(n)g raatee saachai naam piaare ||
lines.translation: She is the happy soul-bride of her Lord, who is forever imbued with the Love of the True Name of her Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗਹੀਐ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: apune gur mil raheeai a(n)mrit gaheeai dubidhaa maar nivaare ||
lines.translation: Abiding in the Company of our Guru, we grasp the Ambrosial Nectar; we conquer and cast out our sense of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman har var paaiaa sagale dookh visaare ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride attains her Husband Lord, and forgets all her pains. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਭੁਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaman pirahu bhulee jeeu maaiaa mohi piaare ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride has forgotten her Husband Lord, because of love and emotional attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੀ ਝੂਠਿ ਲਗੀ ਜੀਉ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhoothee jhooth lagee jeeu kooR muthee kooRiaare ||
lines.translation: The false bride is attached to falsehood; the insincere one is cheated by insincerity.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੇ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR nivaare guramat saare jooai janam na haare ||
lines.translation: She who drives out her falsehood, and acts according to the Guru's Teachings, does not lose her life in the gamble.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabad seve sach samaavai vichahu haumai maare ||
lines.translation: One who serves the Word of the Guru's Shabad is absorbed in the True Lord; she eradicates egotism from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ਐਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam ridai vasaae aisaa kare seegaaro ||
lines.translation: So let the Name of the Lord abide within your heart; decorate yourself in this way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman sahaj samaanee jis saachaa naam adhaaro ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride who takes the Support of the True Name is intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਰੀ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil mere preetamaa jeeu tudh bin kharee nimaanee ||
lines.translation: Meet me, O my Dear Beloved. Without You, I am totally dishonored.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨੈਣੀ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai nainee need na aavai jeeu bhaavai a(n)n na paanee ||
lines.translation: Sleep does not come to my eyes, and I have no desire for food or water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਰੀਐ ਹਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: paanee a(n)n na bhaavai mareeai haavai bin pir kiu sukh paaeeai ||
lines.translation: I have no desire for food or water, and I am dying from the pain of separation. Without my Husband Lord, how can I find peace?
